name: elohim_adept
description: an Elohim Adept, a young priestly mage: brown hair under a cream-white hood, a long cream-white robe with a pale-blue stole hanging down the front, a wooden-bead rope belt, a brown leather satchel stuffed with scrolls on a strap across the chest hanging at the screen-left hip, brown shoes, and a tall wooden staff topped by a sparkling pale-blue ice crystal in his LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side holds the satchel strap, an empty fist

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the arm with the crystal-topped staff thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out, the satchel swinging

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up, the empty right hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal top of the staff resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the hood still around his head; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside him, its sparkles gone
